blocks.text: Pani hydrogen ka oxide hai aur is ka chemical formula H₂O hai. Dekhne mein yeh saada sa molecule hai, magar is ki bohat si hairan kun properties (khususiyaat) hain, jin ki wajah se isay “the medium of life” (zindagi ka zariya) kaha jata hai. Hamare jism ka taqreeban do tihai (2/3) hissa pani hai aur hum is ke baghair zinda nahin reh sakte. Asal mein yeh tamam jandaron mein sab se zyada paya jane wala compound hai. Mukhtalif jandaron mein is ki miqdar 65 se 89 percent tak hoti hai. Multicellular (bohat se cells wale) jandaron mein yeh tissue se tissue badalti hai: maslan bone (haddi) ke cells mein taqreeban 20 percent aur brain (dimagh) ke cells mein 85 percent pani hota hai. Pani zindagi ke maadde (protoplasm) ko banane aur qaim rakhne mein, aur zindagi ke kaam ke liye munasib mahol (environment) banane mein aham kirdar ada karta hai. Pani ki bohat si aham properties isay zindagi ke liye zaroori banati hain.
Solvent properties (hal karne ki salahiyat)

Pani bohat si cheezon ko dissolve (hal) kar leta hai. Is ki wajah us ki do properties hain: pani ke molecules ki polarity (dono siron par mukhtalif charge), aur pani ke molecules ki hydrogen bonds banane ki salahiyat.

Pani ke molecule ke do alag sire hain aur har sire par partial (thora sa) charge hai. Hydrogen atom par thora positive aur oxygen atom par thora negative charge hota hai. Aise molecules ko polar molecules kehte hain.
Hydrogen bonds proteins ki three-dimensional (3D) structure aur DNA ke double helix ko qaim rakhne mein madad karte hain.

Ek pani ke molecule ke negative sire ko doosre pani ke molecule ka positive sira apni taraf khenchta hai. Is kamzor kashish (attraction) ko hydrogen bond kehte hain. Pani mein aise bonds ka ek jaal (network) ban jata hai. Pani ki bohat si properties inhi hydrogen bonds ki wajah se hain.
Agar hydrogen bonding na hoti to pani – 80 °C par ubalta aur – 100 °C par jam jata, yani aam darja-e-hararat (temperature) par pani hamesha gas hota aur zindagi mumkin na hoti.

blocks.alt: Beech mein pani ka ek molecule (O aur do H) aur us ke gird chaar molecules. Nuqta-daar (dotted) hydrogen bonds beech wale molecule ke har H ko padosi ke O se, aur us ke O ko do aur padosiyon ke H se jorte hain. O siron par (-) aur H siron par (+) hai; ek bond par Hydrogen bond likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.6: Pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds (kitab ki Figure 4.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Charge wale ya polar molecules, jaise salts, sugars aur amino acids, pani mein aasani se hal ho jate hain, is liye inhein hydrophilic (“pani pasand”) kehte hain. Be-charge ya non-polar molecules, jaise lipids, pani mein hal nahin hote aur inhein hydrophobic (“pani se door bhagne wale”) kehte hain.

Polar hone ki wajah se pani ke molecules har us molecule ke gird jama ho jate hain jis par electrical charge ho, chahe poora charge ho (ions) ya thora sa charge (polar molecules). Maslan jab sodium chloride (namak) pani mein dala jata hai to yeh positive (Na⁺) aur negative (Cl⁻) ions mein toot jata hai. Har ion ko pani ke molecules apne ulte charge wale sire se gher lete hain (Figure 4.7).

blocks.alt: Baayen: NaCl ka crystal, bare hare Cl- aur chhote jamni Na+ ions ki ghani tarteeb. Teer hal shuda ions ki taraf: har Na+ ke gird pani ke molecules apna O sira us ki taraf kiye hain, aur har Cl- ke gird molecules apna H sira us ki taraf kiye hain. Labels: NaCl, Na+, Cl-.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.7: Inorganic molecules (NaCl) ke liye pani bator solvent (kitab ki Figure 4.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani ka O sira thora negative aur H sire thore positive hain. Is liye positive Na⁺ ki taraf pani ke molecules apna O sira karte hain, aur negative Cl⁻ ki taraf apna H sira. Har ion ke gird pani ka yeh ghera ions ko dobara milne nahin deta, aur namak hal ho jata hai.

Isi tarah jab glucose pani mein dala jata hai to pani ke molecules glucose ke polar hydroxyl (OH) groups se hydrogen bonds bana lete hain, aur yun glucose pani mein hal ho jata hai (Figure 4.8). Matlab charge wale ya polar molecules pani mein hal ho jate hain. Solution (mahlool) ki halat mein ions aur molecules aasani se aapas mein react kar sakte hain. Is liye pani chemical reactions, yani cells ke metabolism, ke liye medium (zariya) deta hai.

blocks.alt: Glucose ki ring (upar ring ka O, ek carbon par CH2OH aur baqi chaar par OH), aur har hydroxyl group ke paas pani ka ek molecule jo nuqta-daar hydrogen bond se jura hai. Labels: Glucose, Hydroxyl group, Hydrogen bond, Water.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.8: Organic molecules (glucose) ke liye pani bator solvent (kitab ki Figure 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yani charge wale ya polar molecules pani mein hal hote hain. Solution mein ions aur molecules aasani se react kar lete hain, is liye pani metabolism (cells ke andar chemical reactions) ka medium hai.

Polar molecules jaise salts, sugars aur amino acids pani mein jaldi hal hote hain aur hydrophilic (pani pasand) kehlate hain. Be-charge ya non-polar molecules jaise lipids pani mein hal nahin hote aur hydrophobic (pani se door rehne wale) kehlate hain. (Kitab yeh baat upar wale box mein bhi keh chuki hai.)
Hydrophobic exclusion (pani se bahar dhakelna)

Non-polar ya be-charge molecules pani mein hal nahin hote, kyun ke pani ke molecules un se hydrogen bonds nahin banate. Jab inhein pani mein dala jata hai to pani ke molecules inhein bahar dhakel dete hain. Yeh na-hal hone wale molecules aapas mein hydrophobic jor (associations) bana lete hain. Maslan lipid molecules pani mein hal nahin hote; pani se bahar dhakele jane par yeh aapas mein mazbooti se jur jate hain. Isi liye lipids cells ki membranes qaim rakhne mein madad karte hain (Figure 4.9: pani mein tel ki boondein aapas mein jur jati hain).
Heat capacity (garmi jazb karne ki salahiyat)

Specific heat capacity woh garmi (calories mein) hai jo kisi cheez ke 1 gram ka temperature 15 °C se 16 °C, yani 1 °C, barhane ke liye chahiye. Pani ki specific heat capacity zyada hai: 4.184 joules (yani 1 gram pani ko 1 °C garam karne ke liye 4.184 J ya 1 calorie chahiye). Is ka matlab hai ke pani apna temperature bohat kam badle baghair bohat si garmi jazb (absorb) bhi kar sakta hai aur chhor bhi sakta hai. Pani jo garmi jazb karta hai us ka zyada hissa molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torne mein kharch hota hai. Bonds tootne ke baad molecules zyada azadi se harkat karne lagte hain aur tab pani ka temperature barhta hai.
Pani ki specific heat zyada tar carbon compounds se do guna aur iron (loha) se nau guna zyada hai.

Specific heat zyada hone ki wajah se pani aahista garam hota hai. Isi tarah thande mahol mein bhi yeh apna temperature der tak qaim rakhta hai. Is tarah pani jandaron ke andar ke mahol aur bahar ke mahol dono ke temperature ko stable (ek jaisa) rakhta hai.
Heat of vaporization (bhaap banne ki garmi)

Heat of vaporization woh garmi hai jo kisi liquid (maaye) ko gas banane ke liye chahiye. Pani ki heat of vaporization zyada hai, is liye liquid se gas bante waqt yeh bohat garmi jazb karta hai. Pani ki heat of vaporization 574 Kcal/kg hai, yani 1 kg liquid pani ko bhaap banane ke liye kafi zyada garmi (574 Kcal) chahiye.
Ek litre pani mein se sirf 2 ml pani bhaap ban jaye to baqi 998 ml pani ka temperature 1 °C kam ho jata hai.

Is property ki wajah se zameen ka temperature motadil (na zyada garam, na zyada thanda) rehta hai. Jab poday transpire karte hain (patton se pani bhaap ban kar nikalta hai) aur janwar perspire karte hain (paseena), to unhein thandak milti hai. Poday ya janwar ke jism ki satah se bhaap banne wala har gram pani jism se 574 calories garmi le jata hai.
Cohesion (aapas mein chipakna)

Pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds unhein “aapas mein chipke” rehne dete hain. Ek hi qisam ke molecules ki aapas ki is kashish ko cohesion kehte hain. Pani ke molecules mein cohesion zyada hai, aur yeh jandaron ke liye aham hai. Poday jaron (roots) se patton (leaves) tak pani aur nutrients (ghizai ajza) pohanchane ke liye isi cohesion par depend karte hain. Patte se pani ke bhaap banne se patte ki xylem vessels (pani le jane wali naliyon) ke pani par khinchao (pull) parta hai. Cohesion ki wajah se yeh khinchao xylem vessels ke zariye neeche jaron tak pohanchta hai. Natije mein pani gravity (zameen ki kashish) ke khilaf upar chadhta hai.

Hydrogen bonds pani ko zyada surface tension (satah ka khinchao) bhi dete hain. Pani aise lagta hai jaise us par koi an-dekhi jhilli (film) chadhi ho. Figure 4.10 mein water-strider keera satah tore baghair pani par chal raha hai.
Ionization of water (pani ka ions mein tootna)

Jab pani ke molecule ke atoms ke darmiyan covalent bonds toot-te hain to pani ionize ho kar hydrogen ions (H⁺) aur hydroxyl ions (OH⁻) bana deta hai. Aam halaat mein yeh reaction reversible (dono taraf chalne wala) hai aur equilibrium (tawazun) qaim rehta hai. Room temperature (25 °C) par ek litre pani mein har 550 million molecules mein se sirf ek ionize hota hai. Is liye khalis pani mein H⁺ aur OH⁻ dono ki concentration 10⁻⁷ moles/litre rehti hai.

Acids OH⁻ ions se mil jate hain aur H⁺ ions mahol mein bach jate hain, is liye mahol acidic ho jata hai. Isi tarah bases H⁺ ions se mil jate hain aur OH⁻ ions bach jate hain, is liye mahol basic ho jata hai.

H⁺ aur OH⁻ ions cells ke bohat se chemical reactions mein hissa lete hain, maslan macromolecules ki hydrolysis. H⁺ aur OH⁻ ki aapas ki miqdar (relative concentration) mahol ki acidity aur alkalinity, yani pH, tay karti hai. pH biochemical reactions par asar dalta hai; enzymes ek khaas pH par sab se acha kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Pani ka molecule (bara O aur do H) -> hydroxyl ion (O aur ek H; O par teer us electron ko dikhata hai jo O apne paas rakhta hai) + hydrogen ion (akela H). Labels: Water molecule H2O, Hydroxyl ion OH-, Hydrogen ion H+.

blocks.text: Maximum density at 4 °C (4 °C par sab se zyada density)

Pani ki density (ghanapan) 4 °C par sab se zyada hoti hai. Is se neeche temperature girne par us ki density kam hone lagti hai, kyun ke hydrogen bonds pani ke molecules ko kuch door door rakhte hain. 0 °C par pani jam jata hai, magar banne wali barf (ice) liquid pani se kam dense hoti hai, kyun ke is temperature par hydrogen bonding molecules ko liquid pani se bhi zyada door rakhti hai.

Darya, nadiyon aur jheelon mein temperature girne par barf upar satah par banti hai. Barf pani se kam dense hai is liye satah par tairti hai. Yeh insulator (garmi ko guzarne na dene wali teh) ka kaam karti hai aur neeche ke pani ki garmi bahar nahin nikalne deti. Is tarah aquatic (pani mein rehne wale) jandar mehfooz rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Sardiyon mein ek talaab upar se jam jata hai. Pani ki do properties se samjhayein ke neeche machhliyan kyun zinda rehti hain.
blocks.explanation: Barf liquid pani se kam dense hai, kyun ke 0 °C par hydrogen bonds molecules ko zyada door rakhte hain; is liye barf upar tairti hai aur neeche ke pani ko insulate karti hai. Pani ki specific heat zyada hai, is liye neeche ka pani bohat aahista thanda hota hai aur machhliyon ke liye liquid aur kam-o-besh ek jaise temperature par rehta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Pani jandaron ka 65 se 89 percent hai aur “medium of life” hai. Is ka molecule polar hai aur hydrogen bonds ka jaal banata hai.

Solvent: polar aur charge wali cheezein (salts, sugars, amino acids) hydrophilic hain aur hal hoti hain; non-polar lipids hydrophobic hain aur bahar dhakele jate hain, jis se membranes qaim rehti hain.

Zyada specific heat (4.184 J) temperature stable rakhti hai; zyada heat of vaporization (574 Kcal/kg) bhaap ke zariye thandak deti hai aur zameen ko motadil rakhti hai; cohesion pani ko xylem mein upar le jati hai aur surface tension deti hai.

Ionization se H⁺ aur OH⁻ bante hain (har ek 10⁻⁷ moles/litre); yeh pH tay karte hain aur enzymes ko khaas pH chahiye. 4 °C par sab se zyada density ki wajah se barf tairti hai aur aquatic zindagi bachati hai.
